title: Websites and projects
summary: A grouping under a customer, for when one customer has several ongoing things.
html:
A website — or project, which is the same record under a different name — sits under a customer and groups quotes, jobs and invoices together.

It earns its place when one customer has several separate streams of work. A design agency with a client who has three sites wants the invoices for each kept apart; without this layer they all land in one undifferentiated list under the customer.

Creating one

Open the customer and add a website. The useful fields are the name, the address, and anything you need to remember about where it is hosted and when things expire.

Attaching work to it

When creating a quote, job or invoice for that customer, pick the website. From then on the website's own screen shows everything belonging to it, with its own totals.

If you do not need it

Plenty of businesses have one relationship per customer and no use for this layer. The plugin can be switched off in Settings → Plugins, which removes the menu and the field from the forms. See The plugin system.
